Thanks for sending this. The more specific you are, the faster we can fix it. None of these fields are required, but each one you fill in helps.

Please don't post API keys, passwords, or private data from your screen. Check your logs and screenshots before you attach them.

## What happened

What you saw. A sentence or two is plenty.

## What you expected to happen

What you thought Relay would do.

## How to make it happen again

If you can reproduce it, walk us through the steps. If it only happened once and you can't, say so.

1.
2.
3.

## Relay version

Open **Settings → Data & Alerts**. The **App updates** section says "You're on v…". It looks like `0.8.8`.

## Windows version

Press the Windows key, type `winver`, and press Enter. Copy what it says.

## Where it ran

- [ ] My Desktop
- [ ] A Private Workspace
- [ ] Started by an agent through the Agent Bridge (please say which agent, and its tier)

## What you asked Relay to do

If this happened during a mission, paste the goal you typed. If you can, attach the plan too. History → export the mission as JSON.

## Run report

If a run failed, open **Run results** under the plan and click **Export run report**. Attach the JSON file. It holds every step's verdict.

## System logs

Open **Settings → System Logs**, click **Copy all**, and paste the relevant part below. The last few minutes before the problem is usually enough.

```
(paste logs here)
```

## Anything else

Screenshots, screen recordings, hunches. You can drag images straight into the issue.
